title: A monkey born from stone
summary: A stone on the summit of Flower-Fruit Mountain, in the land of Purvavideha, splits open and a stone monkey steps out. Golden light shoots from his eyes up to heaven. Historically: Yuntai Shan at Lianyungang has a Water Curtain Cave and local tradition claims it as the original; Huai'an, the home usually given for the author Wu Cheng'en, is not far away.
summary_zh: 东胜神洲傲来国花果山顶有仙石迸裂，化出一只石猴，目运金光，射冲斗府。史实：连云港云台山有水帘洞，当地以为花果山原型；通常认为的作者吴承恩是淮安人，淮安距此不远。

title: Patriarch Subodhi names him Sun Wukong
place_zh: 灵台方寸山斜月三星洞（西牛贺洲）
summary: Across the western sea he finds the Patriarch Subodhi, who gives him the surname Sun and the religious name Wukong, Awake to Emptiness. The mountain's name is a riddle for the heart, as is the cave's.
summary_zh: 过西海至西牛贺洲，在灵台方寸山斜月三星洞拜须菩提祖师为师，得姓孙，法名悟空。山名、洞名都是“心”字的隐语。

title: King of the Water Curtain Cave
summary: The monkeys find a cave behind a waterfall. The stone monkey is first to leap through, and the troop makes him their Handsome Monkey King.
summary_zh: 群猴寻得瀑布后的洞天，石猴率先跳入，众猴拜为美猴王，洞名水帘洞。

title: He crosses the sea to find a teacher
summary: Afraid of death, the Monkey King sails away on a raft. For eight or nine years he wanders the towns of Jambudvipa, learning human manners and finding only people chasing fame and profit.
summary_zh: 美猴王忧惧生死，独驾木筏漂洋过海，在南赡部洲游历八九年，学人礼、穿人衣，所见皆为名利之徒。

title: The seventy-two transformations and the somersault cloud
summary: The patriarch taps him three times on the head; Wukong understands and comes at the third watch to learn the secret of long life, then the seventy-two transformations and a somersault that covers 108,000 li. Showing off, he is sent away and told never to name his teacher.
summary_zh: 祖师打他三下，悟空会意三更来求，得长生妙道，又学七十二般变化和一个十万八千里的筋斗云。后因卖弄被逐，不许提起师门。

title: He kills the Demon of Havoc
summary: Home again, he finds a demon has been carrying off his monkeys. He kills it with its own sword and starts drilling the troop as an army.
summary_zh: 回到花果山，见混世魔王掳掠群猴，悟空夺刀斩之，从此操练猴兵。

title: The As-You-Will gold-banded staff
place: Dragon Palace of the Eastern Sea
place_zh: 东海龙宫（神话投影于东海）
summary: Looking for a weapon, Wukong goes down to the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea and pulls out the iron pillar that once measured the depth of the Milky Way: the As-You-Will Gold-Banded Staff, 13,500 catties, which shrinks to a needle. He bullies the other dragon kings out of a suit of armour.
summary_zh: 悟空入东海龙宫求兵器，拔走大禹治水时定江海深浅的神珍铁，即如意金箍棒，重一万三千五百斤，可小如绣花针；又向四海龙王勒索了一副披挂。

title: He strikes his name from the Book of Life and Death
place_zh: 幽冥地府（神话投影于泰山）
summary: Two ghosts drag him off in his sleep. He fights his way into the courts of the dead and crosses out his own name and every monkey's from the register. The Dragon King and the King of the Dead both petition heaven. Mount Tai was where Chinese belief put the governance of the dead.
summary_zh: 醉梦中被勾魂鬼使拘入幽冥，悟空打进森罗殿，将生死簿上自己和群猴的名字一笔勾销。龙王、阎王一同上表天庭告状。中国旧俗以泰山主治鬼魂。

title: Made Keeper of the Heavenly Horses
summary: On the Great White Planet's advice the Jade Emperor summons Wukong instead of punishing him and makes him keeper of the heavenly horses. When he learns the post has no rank at all, he smashes his way out and goes home.
summary_zh: 玉帝听太白金星之言，招安悟空上天，封为弼马温。悟空得知这官“未入流”，打出南天门回花果山。

title: The Great Sage Equal to Heaven
summary: Heaven gives in and grants the empty title of Great Sage Equal to Heaven, with a residence but no duties. He spends his days making friends among the stars, and is later put in charge of the Peach Garden to keep him busy.
summary_zh: 天庭只好承认“齐天大圣”空衔，有官无禄，悟空终日结交星宿，后来被派去看管蟠桃园。

title: Heaven's army fails at Flower-Fruit Mountain
summary: Heavenly King Li and his son Nezha lead an army against him. Wukong beats the vanguard and Nezha, and raises a banner reading Great Sage Equal to Heaven.
summary_zh: 托塔李天王与哪吒三太子领天兵下界征讨，悟空连败巨灵神和哪吒，竖起“齐天大圣”大旗。

title: He wrecks the Peach Banquet and steals the elixir
summary: Not invited to the Queen Mother's Peach Banquet, he eats the peaches of immortality, drinks the banquet wine, wanders drunk into Laozi's palace and eats the gourds of golden elixir, then flees home. A hundred thousand heavenly soldiers come for him.
summary_zh: 王母开蟠桃会不请齐天大圣，悟空偷吃蟠桃、御酒，醉闯兜率宫吃尽老君金丹，逃回花果山。天庭发十万天兵围山。

title: Erlang Shen captures the Great Sage
summary: Guanyin recommends the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen. The two fight through transformation after transformation; Wukong turns into a temple and gives himself away with his tail as the flagpole. Laozi knocks him down with a diamond snare and Erlang's dog bites his leg.
summary_zh: 观音举荐二郎显圣真君。二人斗变化，悟空变作土地庙，尾巴竖在庙后当旗杆露了马脚；老君抛金刚琢打中，细犬咬住，终被擒拿。

title: The Buddha's palm and Five Elements Mountain
place_zh: 五行山（即两界山，河州卫以西？）
summary: The Buddha wagers that he cannot leap out of his palm. Wukong somersaults to five pillars at the end of the world, writes his name and pees on one, and finds they are the Buddha's fingers. The palm turns into Five Elements Mountain and pins him for five hundred years. Later chapters place it on the Tang frontier and call it Two Frontiers Mountain.
summary_zh: 如来与他打赌：翻不出掌心便罢。悟空一个筋斗到了天尽头五根肉红柱子，题字撒尿，原来是如来五指。如来翻掌化作五行山，压他五百年。第十四回说明此山在大唐边界，改名两界山。

title: Forty-nine days in the Eight Trigrams Furnace
title_zh: 八卦炉中炼出火眼金睛
summary: No blade can cut him, so Laozi smelts him in his furnace. After forty-nine days he jumps out with fire-golden eyes that see through any disguise, and fights his way to the Hall of Divine Mists.
summary_zh: 刀砍斧剁不能伤，老君将他放入八卦炉中锻炼。七七四十九日后悟空蹬倒丹炉跳出，反炼成一双火眼金睛，一路打到通明殿。

title: The Banquet of Peace in Heaven
summary: The Jade Emperor gives a banquet to thank the Buddha and names it the Banquet of Peace in Heaven. A local god is set to feed the prisoner iron pellets and molten copper.
summary_zh: 玉帝设宴酬谢如来，名为“安天大会”。如来命土地神看守五行山，饥食铁丸、渴饮铜汁。

title: The Buddha offers three baskets of scripture
place_zh: 灵山雷音寺（神话投影于王舍城灵鹫山）
summary: At the Ullambana feast the Buddha says the people of Jambudvipa are greedy and quarrelsome, and that he has three baskets of true scripture for them, if someone will come from the east to fetch them. Guanyin volunteers to find the pilgrim. Historically: Vulture Peak outside Rajgir, where the Buddha is said to have preached, was a pilgrimage site; Xuanzang describes climbing it.
summary_zh: 盂兰盆会上，如来说南赡部洲贪淫乐祸，有三藏真经可以劝人为善，只待东土有人来取。观音领旨东去寻访取经人。史实：王舍城外的灵鹫山（耆阇崛山）相传为佛陀说法之地，玄奘曾亲往礼拜，《大唐西域记》有记。

title: Guanyin converts the monster of the Flowing Sands
summary: On her way east Guanyin meets a monster who eats travellers and wears a necklace of nine skulls, the skulls of earlier pilgrims. She names him Sha Wujing and tells him to wait for the monk.
summary_zh: 观音东行至流沙河，遇一食人妖怪，项下挂九个取经人的骷髅。观音为他摩顶受戒，取名沙悟净，命他在此等候取经人。

title: Guanyin converts Zhu Wuneng at Fuling Mountain
summary: On Fuling Mountain she meets a pig-faced monster, once Marshal of the Heavenly Reeds, banished for flirting with the moon goddess at the Peach Banquet. She names him Zhu Wuneng.
summary_zh: 福陵山遇一猪脸妖怪，原是天蓬元帅，因蟠桃会酒醉戏弄嫦娥被贬下界，错投猪胎。观音赐名猪悟能。

title: Guanyin saves the White Dragon
summary: She asks the Jade Emperor to spare the third son of the Dragon King of the Western Sea, condemned for burning his father's pearls, so that he can serve the pilgrim as a horse.
summary_zh: 西海龙王三太子纵火烧了殿上明珠，被判死罪。观音向玉帝讨情，让他在鹰愁涧等候，变作白马驮取经人西去。

title: Guanyin visits Five Elements Mountain
summary: Under the mountain Wukong begs to be let out. Guanyin promises he will be freed when the pilgrim comes, if he takes him as master.
summary_zh: 观音过五行山，悟空求救。观音许他：等取经人到来，拜师保护西行，便可脱身。

title: The orphan of the river
summary: On his way to his post at Jiangzhou the scholar Chen Guangrui is murdered by a boatman, who takes his name and his wife. She sets her newborn adrift on the Yangzi, and a monk of the Jinshan temple raises the boy as River Float. At eighteen he avenges his father. Historically: Xuanzang's family name was indeed Chen, but he came from Goushi near Luoyang, and this story is invented. Many editions print it as an appendix rather than a chapter.
summary_zh: 陈光蕊赴任江州途中被艄公刘洪害死，刘洪冒名上任。殷小姐将新生儿放入江中，金山寺长老收养，取名江流，后出家法名玄奘，十八岁报仇雪恨。史实：玄奘俗姓陈，名祎，洛阳缑氏人（今河南偃师），江流儿的身世是小说虚构。许多版本把这段放在附录。

title: The Dragon King of the Jing River breaks heaven's law
summary: A fortune-teller in Chang'an, Yuan Shoucheng, tells fishermen exactly where to cast. To prove him wrong the Jing River Dragon King changes the hour and amount of the rain heaven ordered, and is sentenced to death.
summary_zh: 长安卦师袁守诚算定渔夫下网之处。泾河龙王为与他赌气，私改降雨时辰、克扣点数，犯了天条，被判斩首。

title: Wei Zheng beheads the dragon in a dream
summary: The dragon begs Emperor Taizong to save him, since the executioner is to be his minister Wei Zheng. Taizong keeps Wei Zheng at chess all day, but Wei Zheng dozes off over the board and beheads the dragon in his dream. Historically: Wei Zheng was Taizong's famously outspoken minister and died in 643.
summary_zh: 龙王求唐太宗搭救，因监斩官是丞相魏征。太宗留魏征对弈，魏征伏案打盹，梦中将龙斩了。史实：魏征是唐太宗朝以直谏闻名的名臣，卒于贞观十七年（643）。

title: Emperor Taizong goes down to the underworld
place_zh: 幽冥地府（神话投影于泰山）
summary: Taizong dies and is summoned to answer the dragon's charge. A judge who was once Wei Zheng's friend adds twenty years to his life. On the way back the ghosts of those killed in his wars mob him, and he promises a great mass for their souls.
summary_zh: 太宗被拘入冥府与龙王对质。判官崔珏是魏征旧友，私改生死簿添了二十年阳寿。还阳路上枉死城冤魂拦路，太宗许下做水陆大会超度亡魂。

title: Two generals guard the palace gate
summary: The dead dragon haunts the emperor every night until the generals Qin Shubao and Yuchi Jingde stand guard at the palace gate in armour. Their portraits are then painted on the gates instead. Historically: both men were real generals of Taizong's, and this legend is the origin of their worship as the door gods still pasted up at New Year.
summary_zh: 龙王冤魂夜夜到宫中索命，秦叔宝、尉迟敬德披挂守门，鬼魅才不敢来，后改画二将像贴在门上。史实：秦琼、尉迟恭都是唐太宗麾下实有的大将，民间至今过年贴二将为门神，即源于此传说。

title: Xuanzang is chosen to lead the mass
summary: The minister Xiao Yu is told to find a monk of virtue for the mass. He picks Chen Xuanzang, River Float, and Taizong appoints him master of the ceremony. Historically: Xiao Yu was a real Tang chancellor and a devout Buddhist.
summary_zh: 太宗命萧瑀选拔有德行的高僧主持水陆大会，选中陈玄奘，封为“天下大阐都僧纲”。史实：萧瑀是唐初实有的宰相，崇信佛法。

title: Liu Quan carries melons to the dead
summary: To thank the Kings of the Underworld for his life, Taizong sends them pumpkins. A man named Liu Quan, whose wife has hanged herself, volunteers to die and carry them.
summary_zh: 太宗还阳后要给十殿阎君送南瓜答谢，均州人刘全因妻子自缢，甘愿舍身进瓜，夫妻在阴司团聚还魂。

title: Taizong sends Xuanzang west
summary: Xuanzang volunteers. Taizong makes him his sworn brother, gives him the name Tripitaka, a travel document, a golden begging bowl and a white horse, and drops a pinch of earth into his wine: better a handful of home earth than ten thousand taels of foreign gold. Historically: the opposite. The Tang had closed the frontier, Xuanzang's request to travel was refused, and he left in secret, in 629 or 627, as a fugitive.
summary_zh: 玄奘自愿西行，太宗与他结为兄弟，赐号三藏，赐通关文牒、紫金钵盂和白马，并拈一撮土放入酒中：宁恋本乡一捻土，莫爱他乡万两金。史实：恰恰相反。当时唐初边关禁止百姓出境，玄奘上表请求被驳回，于贞观三年（629，一说元年）私自偷越出关。

title: Guanyin reveals herself at the great mass
summary: Disguised as a scabby monk, Guanyin sells a cassock and staff at a ruinous price, then interrupts the mass: these are Lesser Vehicle teachings, and the true Great Vehicle scriptures are in the west. She rises into the air in her true form.
summary_zh: 观音变作癞头和尚卖袈裟锡杖，又在大会上高声说这些都是小乘教法，大乘佛法三藏在西天，随即现出真身，驾云而去。

title: Tripitaka leaves Chang'an
summary: Seen off by the court, Tripitaka spends his first night at the Famen Temple, where the monks tell him of the dangers ahead. Historically: Xuanzang left Chang'an in 629 (some say 627) with a monk from Qinzhou, travelling as an ordinary pilgrim through Liangzhou and Guazhou.
summary_zh: 三藏辞别众官出城，首夜宿法门寺，众僧议论西行艰险。史实：贞观三年（629，一说元年），玄奘随秦州僧人孝达离开长安，经秦州、兰州到凉州，一路以普通行僧身份西行。

title: The last Tang garrison at Hezhou
summary: At Hezhou, the border garrison of the Tang, the officers put him up for the night. Beyond lies foreign country. Historically: Xuanzang's real last outpost was Guazhou and the Yumen Pass far to the northwest, where the governor of Liangzhou had orders to send him back.
summary_zh: 过巩州至河州卫，这里是大唐的山河边界，镇边总兵留宿一夜。史实：玄奘真正的出境处在西北的瓜州、玉门关一带，凉州都督李大亮曾奉命逼他返回长安。

title: Captured by tiger demons at Double Fork Ridge
summary: Setting out before dawn, Tripitaka and his two servants fall into a pit. The tiger demon General Yin eats the servants; the Great White Planet rescues the monk.
summary_zh: 三藏摸黑赶路，跌入坑坎，被寅将军（虎精）捉去，两个从人被吃掉。太白金星化作老叟救出三藏。

title: The hunter Liu Boqin
summary: A hunter kills a tiger, takes the monk home, and asks him to chant for his dead father's soul. He escorts him to the frontier mountain and turns back: the land beyond is not Tang.
summary_zh: 猎户刘伯钦打死猛虎，留三藏在家念经超度亡父，又送至两界山下，说山西边不属大唐，不敢再往。

title: Tripitaka frees Sun Wukong
place_zh: 两界山（五行山，河州卫以西？）
summary: Tripitaka peels off the Buddha's seal on the summit and the mountain splits. Wukong bows to him as master, kills a tiger with his staff and dresses in its skin. Historically: at Guazhou Xuanzang took on a foreign guide, Shi Pantuo, who received the precepts from him and then one night drew a knife on him in the desert; some scholars count him among the sources of Sun Wukong.
summary_zh: 三藏揭去山顶如来压帖，五行山崩裂，悟空拜师，当即打死一只猛虎，剥皮做了虎皮裙。史实：玄奘在瓜州收胡人石槃陀为徒作向导，此人受了五戒，过沙漠时却曾夜里拔刀欲害玄奘；有学者以为他是孙悟空形象的来源之一。

title: The golden fillet and the tightening spell
summary: Guanyin, disguised as an old woman, gives Tripitaka a cap with a golden band and a spell. Wukong comes back, tries the cap on, and the band grows into his head; every recitation of the spell splits it with pain.
summary_zh: 观音化作老母，送三藏一顶嵌金花帽和一篇“定心真言”。悟空回来戴上，金箍便长在头上，三藏一念咒他便头痛欲裂。

title: Wukong kills six robbers
summary: Six highwaymen named after the six senses block the road. Wukong kills them all; Tripitaka scolds him for it, and Wukong flies off in a temper to the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea.
summary_zh: 六个强盗拦路，名叫眼看喜、耳听怒、鼻嗅爱、舌尝思、意见欲、身本忧，象征六根。悟空尽数打杀，三藏责他行凶，悟空一怒驾云去了东海龙宫。

title: The dragon at Eagle Grief Stream becomes the horse
place: Eagle Grief Stream, Coiling Snake Mountain
summary: A dragon swallows Tripitaka's horse whole. Guanyin comes, reveals him as the Western Sea dragon prince, and turns him into a white horse for the journey.
summary_zh: 鹰愁涧小白龙一口吞了三藏坐骑。观音到来，说明他是西海龙王三太子，将他化作白马，驮三藏西行。

title: The abbot of Guanyin Temple covets the cassock
summary: Wukong shows off the brocade cassock. The 270-year-old abbot wants it and sets fire to the pilgrims' room; Wukong borrows a fire screen from heaven and fans the flames onto the temple instead.
summary_zh: 悟空卖弄锦襕袈裟，二百七十岁的老院主起了贪心，放火要烧死师徒。悟空借来辟火罩罩住师父，反将风势引向禅院，满寺烧成白地。

title: The Black Bear Demon steals the cassock
summary: In the confusion a bear spirit from Black Wind Mountain makes off with the cassock. Wukong cannot beat him, and fetches Guanyin, who takes the bear as guardian of her island.
summary_zh: 火中黑风山熊罴精盗走袈裟。悟空斗他不过，请来观音，观音化作妖仙骗他吞下仙丹，收为落伽山守山大神。

title: Pigsy at Gao Village
place_zh: 高老庄（书称乌斯藏国界）
summary: A rich farmer's son-in-law turns out to be a pig spirit. Wukong takes the bride's place and fights him; he turns out to be Zhu Wuneng, waiting for the pilgrim, and becomes the second disciple, Zhu Bajie, Eight Precepts. The novel places the village on the border of Tibet.
summary_zh: 高太公家女婿原来是个猪精。悟空变作高小姐与他厮斗，问出他就是观音点化的猪悟能，于是拜三藏为师，取名八戒。书中说高老庄属乌斯藏国界，即西藏。

title: The Crow's Nest Chan Master gives the Heart Sutra
summary: A hermit living in a crow's nest teaches Tripitaka the Heart Sutra, 270 characters, as protection on the road. Historically: according to his biography Xuanzang learned the Heart Sutra in Sichuan from a sick man he had nursed, and recited it to drive away the spectres of the desert. He made the standard Chinese translation in 649.
summary_zh: 浮屠山乌巢禅师传授《多心经》一卷，二百七十字，说遇魔障念此可保无事。史实：据《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》，玄奘在蜀中照料一病人，得授《般若心经》，后在沙漠中遇鬼魅就诵此经；今通行的《心经》汉译本即玄奘649年所译。

title: Wukong fights Bajie at Cloudy Pathway Cave
summary: Before he submits, Bajie flees to his cave and fights Wukong with his nine-toothed rake until Guanyin's name comes up.
summary_zh: 八戒败回福陵山云栈洞，持九齿钉钯与悟空大战，直到听说取经人到了才弃钯投降。

title: The Yellow Wind Demon
summary: A yellow marten demon blows a sandstorm that blinds Wukong and carries Tripitaka off. Historically: the biography describes Xuanzang's desert crossing in much the same terms, with spirit fires at night like stars and by day a wind that drove the sand like rain.
summary_zh: 黄风大王是只得道黄毛貂鼠，一口三昧神风吹得悟空睁不开眼，摄走三藏。史实：《慈恩传》写玄奘过沙漠：“夜则妖魑举火，烂若繁星；昼则惊风拥沙，散如时雨。”

title: Bodhisattva Lingji calms the wind
summary: A disguised god cures Wukong's eyes and sends him to Bodhisattva Lingji, whose wind-fixing pill and flying-dragon staff subdue the marten.
summary_zh: 护法伽蓝化作老者为悟空医眼，指点他请小须弥山灵吉菩萨。菩萨用定风丹、飞龙宝杖降伏了黄风怪。

title: Sha Wujing at the River of Flowing Sands
place_zh: 流沙河（八百里，莫贺延碛？）
summary: A river eight hundred li wide where not even a goose feather floats. Bajie fights the monster in the water; Guanyin's disciple Moksa calls him out, the nine skulls make a raft, and he becomes the third disciple, Sha Wujing, Sandy. Historically: the novel's 'eight hundred li of flowing sand' is the Mokhayan desert beyond the Yumen Pass, which Xuanzang crossed alone; he spilled his water bag and went four nights and five days without a drop.
summary_zh: 八百里流沙河，鹅毛漂不起。八戒与水怪大战，木叉奉观音之命唤出悟净，以九个骷髅结成法船渡河，悟净拜师，称沙和尚。史实：小说的“八百里流沙”即玉门关外的莫贺延碛。玄奘独身穿越，失手打翻水囊，“四夜五日无一滴沾喉”，几乎渴死。

title: Four bodhisattvas test the pilgrims
summary: A rich widow and her three daughters offer to marry the four pilgrims. Only Bajie is tempted; in the morning the house has vanished and he hangs bound in a tree. The widow was the Old Mother of Mount Li with Guanyin, Samantabhadra and Manjusri.
summary_zh: 一位富孀带三个女儿招赘四人，只有八戒动心。天明庄院化为乌有，八戒被吊在树上。原来是黎山老母与观音、普贤、文殊所变。

title: Stealing the ginseng fruit at Wuzhuang Temple
summary: The Immortal Zhenyuan is away and leaves two boys to give Tripitaka two of his ginseng fruits, which ripen once in nine thousand years and look like newborn babies. Tripitaka will not touch them; Bajie talks Wukong into stealing three more.
summary_zh: 镇元大仙外出，嘱两个童子以人参果款待三藏。此果九千年一熟，形如婴孩，三藏不敢吃。八戒撺掇悟空又偷了三个。

title: Wukong knocks down the ginseng tree
summary: Cursed by the boys, Wukong pushes the tree over. Zhenyuan catches the pilgrims in his sleeve twice, and has them fried in oil; Wukong swaps himself for a stone lion and cracks the cauldron.
summary_zh: 童子辱骂，悟空一怒推倒果树。镇元大仙两番用袖里乾坤拿住四众，又要下油锅；悟空以石狮替身，砸破了油锅。

title: Guanyin's sweet dew revives the tree
summary: Wukong searches the three islands of the immortals for a cure and finds it only with Guanyin, whose vase water brings the tree back to life. Zhenyuan holds a feast and swears brotherhood with Wukong.
summary_zh: 悟空遍访蓬莱、方丈、瀛洲三岛求医树之方，最后求得观音净瓶甘露，救活人参果树。镇元大仙设人参果会，与悟空结为兄弟。

title: Three times he strikes the White Bone Demon
summary: A skeleton demon comes to the pilgrims as a village girl, then her old mother, then her old father. Each time Wukong sees through her and strikes; each time she escapes in spirit and leaves a corpse behind, and Bajie tells Tripitaka his disciple is murdering mortals.
summary_zh: 白骨夫人先后变作村姑、老妇、老翁来骗唐僧，悟空三次识破，三次打杀。妖精每回都遗下假尸脱身，八戒在旁挑唆，说师兄打死了凡人。

title: Tripitaka drives Wukong away
summary: Tripitaka writes Wukong a letter of dismissal. Wukong kneels to him four times, splits off copies of himself so that he is bowed to from every side, and goes home in tears.
summary_zh: 唐僧写下贬书，赶走悟空。悟空跪拜四方，拔毫毛变作分身围住师父拜别，含泪驾云回花果山。

title: The Yellow Robe Monster of Moon Waves Cave
summary: Without Wukong, Tripitaka walks into a cave in a dark pine forest and is caught by the Yellow Robe Monster, who has kept a princess of Baoxiang as his wife for thirteen years. She lets the monk go with a letter to her father.
summary_zh: 师父没了悟空，误入黑松林波月洞，被黄袍怪拿住。洞中百花羞是宝象国公主，被摄来十三年，私放三藏，托他捎家书。

title: Wukong rebuilds his kingdom on Flower-Fruit Mountain
summary: Hunters have burned and trapped the mountain since he left. Wukong kills a thousand of them with a wind spell, replants the slopes and raises his banner again.
summary_zh: 悟空离山后猎户烧山捕猴。他回山作法刮起狂风，砸死千余猎户，重整花果山，竖起“重修花果山，复整水帘洞，齐天大圣”大旗。

title: The princess's letter reaches Baoxiang
summary: Tripitaka has his passport stamped and delivers the letter. The king begs the pilgrims to rescue his daughter; Bajie and Sandy go and are beaten.
summary_zh: 三藏入宝象国倒换关文，呈上公主家书。国王求他们降妖救女，八戒、沙僧前去，一个逃回、一个被擒。

title: Tripitaka turned into a tiger
summary: The monster comes to court as a handsome son-in-law, accuses Tripitaka of being a tiger spirit and turns him into one. The white horse becomes a dragon again and fights him, and is wounded.
summary_zh: 黄袍怪变作俊俏驸马上殿，反诬唐僧是虎精，一口法水将他变作斑斓猛虎。白马化回龙身夜战妖魔，负伤而回。

title: Bajie goads Wukong into coming back
summary: The dragon horse sends Bajie to Flower-Fruit Mountain. Wukong refuses until Bajie claims the monster mocked him, and then he comes.
summary_zh: 白龙马劝八戒去花果山请大师兄。悟空起初不肯，八戒谎说妖精辱骂猴王，悟空大怒，随他回来。

title: The monster is the Wolf Star
summary: Wukong takes the princess's place and fights the monster, who vanishes. In heaven a roll-call finds the star Kui, the Wooden Wolf, missing: he and the princess were lovers in a former life. He is sent back to tend Laozi's fire.
summary_zh: 悟空变作公主与妖怪交手，妖精忽然不见。上天查点，二十八宿中少了奎木狼，原来他与公主前世有情，私下凡尘。被罚给太上老君烧火。

title: The silver-horned king catches Bajie
summary: A god warns them of Flat-Top Mountain. Bajie, sent ahead to scout, naps and lies, and is caught by the Silver-Horned King.
summary_zh: 功曹化作樵夫报信，说平顶山莲花洞有金角、银角二魔。八戒巡山偷懒说谎，被银角大王拿去。

title: The calabash that answers to your name
summary: The demons have five treasures. The purple-gold gourd sucks in anyone who answers when called by name. Wukong is caught as 'Sun Xingzhe', gets out, and catches the Silver-Horned King back as 'Xingzhe Sun'.
summary_zh: 二魔有五件宝贝。紫金红葫芦叫一声名字，答应了便被装进去化为脓水。悟空以“者行孙”“行者孙”的假名应答，先被装入又脱出，反将银角大王装了进去。

title: Wukong pinned under three mountains
summary: The Silver-Horned King summons Mount Sumeru, Mount Emei and Mount Tai and drops them on Wukong. The local gods lift them off.
summary_zh: 银角大王遣来须弥山、峨眉山、泰山，把悟空压在山下，土地山神只得将山移开。

title: The two kings were Laozi's furnace boys
summary: With all five treasures in hand Wukong wins. Laozi appears to claim his two boys, who tend his gold and silver furnaces and were lent to Guanyin to test the pilgrims.
summary_zh: 悟空夺尽五件宝贝，收伏二魔。太上老君前来认领，原来金角、银角是他看金炉、银炉的童子，是观音借来考验取经人的。

title: A night at Baolin Temple
summary: The abbot of Baolin Temple turns the pilgrims away until Wukong threatens him with his staff. Tripitaka and his disciples talk under the full moon about the moon and the mind.
summary_zh: 宝林寺僧官起初不肯留宿，悟空亮出金箍棒才吓得满寺五百僧人出迎。师徒月下谈月论心。

title: The ghost of the King of Wuji
summary: In a dream the drowned King of Wuji comes to Tripitaka: three years ago a Taoist who had ended a drought pushed him into a well, took his shape and his throne. He leaves a white jade tablet as proof.
summary_zh: 乌鸡国王的冤魂夜入唐僧梦中：三年前一个道士求雨有功，与他结拜，却将他推入御花园八角琉璃井中，变作他的模样篡了王位。留下白玉圭为证。

title: The true and false kings of Wuji
summary: Wukong tells the crown prince the truth, Bajie fishes the king's body out of the well, and Wukong fetches a pill of Laozi's elixir from heaven to bring him back to life. At court the false king is unmasked; he is the blue-haired lion Manjusri rides.
summary_zh: 悟空向太子说明真相，八戒下井背出国王尸身，悟空上天向老君讨来九转还魂丹救活国王。金殿上假国王现形，原来是文殊菩萨坐骑青毛狮子，奉佛旨来报当年国王浸文殊三日之仇。

title: Red Boy hangs himself from a tree
summary: On Mount Hao a child is tied in a tree, crying for help. Wukong sees a demon; Tripitaka insists on rescuing him. Riding on Wukong's back he grows heavier and heavier, then whirls the monk away.
summary_zh: 号山松树上吊着个啼哭的孩童，悟空认出是妖，唐僧却执意救他。红孩儿骑在悟空背上越来越重，旋风一卷，摄走了唐僧。

title: Red Boy's samadhi fire
summary: Red Boy, son of the Bull Demon King, breathes a fire that water cannot put out. The dragon kings' rain only makes it fiercer; Wukong is burned and dunked and nearly dies.
summary_zh: 红孩儿是牛魔王之子，口吐三昧真火，龙王降雨反而火上浇油，悟空被烧得冷水一激，几乎丧命。

title: Guanyin tames Red Boy
summary: Bajie, sent for Guanyin, is tricked by Red Boy disguised as her and hung up in a bag. Wukong goes himself. Guanyin lures Red Boy onto her lotus seat, which turns into blades, and fits him with five golden rings. He becomes her acolyte Sudhana.
summary_zh: 八戒去请观音，被红孩儿假扮的观音骗入皮袋。悟空亲赴南海，观音化天罡刀作莲台诱红孩儿坐上，又以五个金箍套住他，收为善财童子。

title: The alligator dragon of the Black River
summary: A ferryman on the Black River is the alligator dragon, a nephew of the Western Sea Dragon King, and sinks the boat with Tripitaka in it. The Dragon King sends his son to arrest him.
summary_zh: 黑水河艄公是鼍龙所变，将唐僧连船沉入河底。此怪是西海龙王外甥，龙王只得派太子摩昂前来擒拿。

title: Monks enslaved in Cheqi
summary: In Cheqi three Taoist masters ended a drought twenty years ago, and since then the king has made the monks haul carts to build Taoist temples. Five hundred are left alive. Wukong frees them.
summary_zh: 车迟国二十年前大旱，虎力、鹿力、羊力三位道士求雨有功，被尊为国师，国王便罚和尚为道士拉车修观，只剩五百人。悟空救下众僧。

title: Wukong, Bajie and Sandy sit as the Three Pure Ones
place: Temple of the Three Pure Ones
summary: At night the three disciples throw the statues in the privy, sit in their places and eat the offerings. When the Taoists ask for holy water, they get urine.
summary_zh: 三人夜入三清观，将三清圣像丢进茅厕，自己坐上神台吃供品，道士求圣水，赐的却是尿。

title: The contest at Cheqi
summary: The pilgrims and the three Taoists compete before the king at calling rain, sitting in meditation, guessing what is in a closed chest, being beheaded, being disembowelled and bathing in boiling oil. Wukong wins every round and the three masters die as a tiger, a deer and an antelope. Historically: Xuanzang passed through Agni, around Karashahr, and recorded a dozen Buddhist monasteries with two thousand monks of the Lesser Vehicle there; nothing like Taoists ruling and monks enslaved.
summary_zh: 师徒与三位国师在国王面前斗求雨、斗坐禅、隔板猜枚、砍头、剖腹剜心、滚油洗澡，悟空场场取胜，三怪现出虎、鹿、羊原形。史实：玄奘经阿耆尼国（今焉耆一带），记其国有佛寺十余所、僧徒二千余人，习学小乘，与小说所写道士当国、和尚为奴正相反。

title: The Great King of Miraculous Power
place_zh: 通天河陈家庄（青海玉树一带？）
summary: The river is eight hundred li wide, and every year the village must give a boy and a girl to the Great King of Miraculous Power. Wukong and Bajie turn into the two children and go to the temple to be eaten. Historically: Tongtian, Heaven-Reaching, is the real name of the upper Yangzi around Yushu in Qinghai, but Xuanzang's real route never went near it.
summary_zh: 通天河宽八百里，陈家庄每年要献童男童女给灵感大王享用。悟空、八戒变作两个孩童，被抬入庙中。史实：通天河是长江上源在青海玉树一带的实有名称，但玄奘的真实路线并不经过这里。

title: Walking across the frozen river
summary: The demon freezes the river in midsummer. Merchants cross on the ice and the pilgrims follow; in the middle the ice breaks and Tripitaka is taken down to the demon's palace under the water.
summary_zh: 妖怪作法六月飘雪、通天河封冻。商客踏冰而行，唐僧急于赶路随之过河，行至河心冰裂，被妖怪擒入水府。

title: Guanyin with the fish basket
summary: Wukong finds Guanyin in her bamboo grove, not yet dressed, plaiting a basket. She drops it into the river and draws out a goldfish from her lotus pond, the demon. The villagers see her in this form and paint it, the origin of Fish-Basket Guanyin.
summary_zh: 悟空到紫竹林，观音未梳妆，正在编竹篮。菩萨将竹篮抛入河中，提起一尾金鱼，就是她莲花池里修成的灵感大王。陈家庄人望见画下像来，世上从此有了“鱼篮观音”。

title: The old turtle carries them across
summary: The white turtle whose home the goldfish took carries the pilgrims across on his back and asks one favour: ask the Buddha how many more years until he can take human form. Tripitaka promises and forgets. It comes back to him in chapter 99.
summary_zh: 被金鱼精占了水府的老白鼋驮师徒过河，只求一事：见了佛祖替他问问几时能得人身。唐僧满口答应，后来却忘了，第九十九回因此落水。

title: The ring drawn on the ground
place: Golden Helmet Cave, Golden Helmet Mountain
summary: Wukong draws a circle around Tripitaka and tells him not to step out. Bajie talks him into leaving it, they take three padded vests from an empty house, and are caught. The rhinoceros-buffalo demon's steel ring swallows Wukong's staff.
summary_zh: 悟空出外化斋，用金箍棒在地上画圈让师父坐在圈内。八戒劝师父出圈，在空宅中拿了三件纳锦背心，立刻被擒。兕大王一个白森森的圈子，连金箍棒都套了去。
